business_summary: Samsung SDS Co., Ltd. provides cloud and digital logistics platform-based logistics services in South Korea, the America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and China. It operates in IT Service and Logistics. The IT Service segment offers IT consulting, IT system design and development, system integration, information system operation and maintenance, data centers, and network service outsourcing solutions. The Logistics segment provides global logistics services, such as supply chain and logistics consulting and solutions. It offers cloud transformation, management, and infrastructure, as well as network and security solutions. The company also provides artificial intelligence (AI) services, such as FabriX, an automated data lake management platform; Brightics Machine Learning, an AI-based data analysis platform; Brightics Data Hub, a distributed data platform; and Brightics AI Accelerator, an AutoML suite and AI consulting solution. In addition, it offers Brity Copilot, a generative AI-based collaboration solution; Brity Automation, an AI-driven Brity robotic process automation solution; Caidentia, an AI-powered procurement and N-tier supplier relationship management solution; manufacturing execution system, an unstructured data analysis platform; share space management and workplace book; and digital health solutions comprising remote patient monitoring and interactive patient care. Further, it provides enterprise mobility solutions, including zero touch mobility; managed mobility services; EMM (On-Prem), an enterprise solution that simplifies managing and setting up employees devices;); secure settings; Data Sweeper, a solution which helps in clearing application data; and Inertia, a solution that improves productivity and safety within warehouse operations, as well as enterprise solutions and digital transformations services. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 삼성SDS(주)는 한국, 미주, 유럽, 아시아, 아프리카, 중국 지역에서 클라우드 및 디지털 물류 플랫폼 기반 물류 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. IT 서비스 및 물류 부문을 운영하고 있습니다. IT 서비스 부문은 IT 컨설팅, IT 시스템 설계 및 개발, 시스템 통합, 정보 시스템 운영 및 유지 관리, 데이터 센터, 네트워크 서비스 아웃소싱 솔루션을 제공합니다. 물류 부문은 공급망, 물류 컨설팅 및 솔루션과 같은 글로벌 물류 서비스를 제공합니다. 클라우드 전환, 관리, 인프라는 물론 네트워크 및 보안 솔루션도 제공합니다. 이 회사는 또한 자동화된 데이터 레이크 관리 플랫폼인 FabriX와 같은 인공지능(AI) 서비스도 제공합니다. AI 기반 데이터 분석 플랫폼 Brightics Machine Learning 분산 데이터 플랫폼인 Brightics Data Hub; AutoML 제품군이자 AI 컨설팅 솔루션인 Brightics AI Accelerator입니다. 또한 생성적 AI 기반 협업 솔루션인 Brity Copilot을 제공합니다. AI 기반 Brity 로봇 프로세스 자동화 솔루션인 Brity Automation AI 기반 조달 및 N 계층 공급업체 관계 관리 솔루션인 Caidentia 제조 전자
